name: 2 inch Enviro Water Structuring Device
shortDescription: The Enviro 2” Water Structuring Device is a maintenance-free, chemical-free solution designed for high-flow residential, commercial, and industrial water systems. It helps reduce hard water scaling, protects equipment and plumbing, and operates without electricity, salt, filters, or replacement parts.
description:
Key Features

  • Fully Automatic Operation
  • No Moving Parts
  • No Electricity Required
  • No Chemicals or Salt Usage
  • No Filters or Consumables
  • Minimal Maintenance
  • Durable and Long-Lasting Design
  • Suitable for High-Flow Water Systems

About Product

The Enviro 2” Water Structuring Device is a fully automatic water conditioning solution designed for larger residential, commercial, and industrial applications. It helps reduce the scale-forming properties of hard water without using chemicals, salt, or electricity. The system protects pipelines, plumbing fixtures, water heaters, boilers, cooling systems, and other equipment from mineral buildup, helping to extend their service life and improve operational efficiency. It minimizes mineral deposits on fixtures and surfaces, reducing maintenance and cleaning requirements while keeping water systems running smoothly. With no moving parts, filters, or consumables, the device offers hassle-free operation, minimal maintenance, and no recurring replacement costs. Ideal for apartment complexes, residential communities, hotels, hospitals, educational institutions, commercial buildings, and industrial process water systems, it provides a reliable and eco-friendly solution for hard water management. By naturally conditioning water and reducing scale formation, the Enviro 2” Water Structuring Device helps maintain cleaner plumbing systems, improves equipment longevity, and supports efficient water usage for high-flow applications.

  • Odourless and Tasteless Media

About Product

Enviro Brine+ Hard Water Conditioner is designed to protect homes from the damaging effects of hard water caused by high levels of calcium and magnesium minerals commonly found in borewell water. It helps reduce white scaling and mineral deposits on taps, showerheads, bathroom tiles, pipelines, geysers, and other household appliances, keeping your home cleaner and better protected. The advanced conditioning technology utilizes a proprietary process that alters the behavior of calcium minerals, helping them remain in a non-adherent state and reducing their tendency to form hard scale deposits inside pipes and on surfaces. By minimizing scaling and corrosion, the system helps extend the lifespan of plumbing networks, geyser heating elements, washing machines, and other utility equipment. It also improves the bathing experience by reducing the harsh effects of hard water on skin and hair, contributing to a cleaner and healthier living environment. The conditioner operates without chemicals and features odourless, tasteless, and pH-neutral media, making it suitable for residential borewell water applications. Ideal for independent houses, villas, apartments, farmhouses, residential complexes, and utility water lines, Enviro Brine+ delivers reliable performance with minimal maintenance requirements.

Product Description

The 5G PRO Hot, Ambient & Cold Alkaline Water Purifier is a premium, all-in-one water purification system designed to deliver safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water with the convenience of instant hot, ambient, and cold water. Combining advanced purification technology with a sleek glass-finish design and an intelligent touch panel, this purifier is the perfect addition to modern homes, offices, and commercial spaces. Powered by an advanced RO + UV + UF + Alkaline multi-stage purification process, the purifier effectively removes excess Total Dissolved Solids (TDS), dissolved salts, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals, harmful chemicals, pesticides, and other contaminants while retaining essential minerals for healthier drinking water. It is suitable for treating raw water with TDS levels up to 3000 PPM and delivers a purification capacity of 15 litres per hour, ensuring a continuous supply of purified water for your family. The purification system includes a 5 Micron Sediment Filter that removes dust, sand, rust, and suspended particles, protecting the internal filters and extending their life. A 100 GPD Imported Booster Pump ensures consistent water pressure for efficient purification, while the 100 GPD RO Membrane significantly reduces dissolved impurities and excess TDS. To further enhance water quality, the purifier features Coconut Shell Activated Carbon (1100 IV), which effectively removes chlorine, unpleasant taste, odor, and organic impurities, delivering fresh and naturally pleasant-tasting drinking water. The 4-inch UF Filter provides an additional layer of filtration by removing fine suspended particles and microorganisms without affecting beneficial minerals. For superior microbial protection, the purifier is equipped with a powerful 5W UVC LED In-Tank Sterilization System, which continuously disinfects stored water and prevents bacterial growth inside the storage tank, ensuring every glass of water remains hygienic even after storage. The integrated Bio AA+ Alkaline Filter enriches purified water with essential minerals such as calcium and magnesium while balancing the pH level to produce healthy alkaline drinking water that supports better hydration and improved taste. One of the standout features of the 5G PRO is its Vegetable Detoxifier, which helps remove pesticide residues, harmful chemicals, and surface contaminants from fruits and vegetables, providing an additional level of protection for your family's daily food preparation. The purifier is equipped with a modern Touch Panel featuring Real-Time TDS Monitoring, allowing users to easily monitor the quality of purified water. A Manual TDS Adjuster enables precise control over mineral retention, allowing you to customize the taste and mineral content according to your local water conditions and personal preference. Designed for maximum convenience, the purifier includes separate storage tanks for multiple temperature options:
  • 4 Litres Ambient Water
  • 1 Litre Hot Water
  • 0.8 Litre Cold Water
Whether you need chilled drinking water during summer, hot water for tea, coffee, or instant foods, or ambient water for everyday hydration, the 5G PRO delivers water instantly at your preferred temperature. The purifier operates using an energy-efficient SMPS Power Supply (220V AC / 24V DC – 30W). Power consumption is optimized with 30W during RO purification, 550W while heating, 60W during cooling, and only 5W for the Vegetable Detoxifier, ensuring reliable performance with efficient energy usage. Constructed with a Premium ABS Food-Grade Cabinet and an elegant tempered glass front panel, the 5G PRO offers excellent durability, easy maintenance, and a sophisticated appearance that complements any modern kitchen or workspace. Its versatile Wall Mountable and Table Top installation options provide flexibility to suit different spaces and user requirements. Combining intelligent technology, multi-stage purification, alkaline mineral enhancement, hot and cold dispensing, UVC in-tank protection, and a premium aesthetic design, the 5G PRO Hot, Ambient & Cold Alkaline Water Purifierdelivers a complete drinking water solution for families seeking safety, convenience, performance, and style.
